name: Shokushu Ningen ~Akogare no Idol Hen~
original_name: 触手人間 ～憧れのアイドル編～
source:
One man ate that fruit to see if the legend was true. 
Its transformative powers made him a human monster. 
You are the hero! You are... Tentacleman! 

This time you encounter with an idol girl Erina Misaki and accompanies her to her home.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE064412.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一名男子为了确认传说是否属实，吃下了那枚果实。
果实的变化之力将他变成了人类怪物。
你就是英雄！你就是……触手人！

这一次，你会遇到偶像少女三咲惠里菜，并陪她回家。

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE064412.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
